objective: Cerrar Gate C de SoftRestaurant mediante auditoria SQL global estrictamente READ_ONLY despues de completar 130MID, CIENFUEGOS y ESTELAR. Validar presencia, cobertura temporal, volumen e idempotencia observable de los cortes canonicos y volumen del detalle de pagos. No ejecutar sincronizaciones, no modificar SQL, no shell, no tocar Production.

queries.name: softrestaurant_cortes_by_unit
queries.sql: SELECT UnidadNegocioID, UnidadNegocioNombre, COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_cortes, MIN(FechaCorte) AS fecha_min, MAX(FechaCorte) AS fecha_max, MAX(FechaSincronizacion) AS ultima_sync FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja WHERE SistemaOrigen = 'SOFTRESTAURANT' GROUP BY UnidadNegocioID, UnidadNegocioNombre ORDER BY UnidadNegocioNombre;

queries.name: softrestaurant_duplicate_identity_check
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS duplicate_groups FROM (SELECT ServerID, FolioCorte FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja WHERE SistemaOrigen = 'SOFTRESTAURANT' GROUP BY ServerID, FolioCorte HAVING COUNT_BIG(*) > 1) d;

queries.name: softrestaurant_total_cortes
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_cortes_softrestaurant FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja WHERE SistemaOrigen = 'SOFTRESTAURANT';

queries.name: detalle_pagos_total_rows
queries.sql: SELECT COUNT_BIG(*) AS total_detalle_pagos FROM dbo.Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos;

queries.name: canonical_tables_columns_snapshot
queries.sql: SELECT t.name AS table_name, c.column_id, c.name AS column_name, ty.name AS data_type FROM sys.tables t INNER JOIN sys.columns c ON c.object_id = t.object_id INNER JOIN sys.types ty ON ty.user_type_id = c.user_type_id WHERE SCHEMA_NAME(t.schema_id) = 'dbo' AND t.name IN ('Finanzas_CortesCaja','Finanzas_CortesCaja_DetallePagos') ORDER BY t.name, c.column_id;

requester.chat: Final SoftRestaurant Gate C global SQL audit
